title: guzmania fastuosa
intro: Guzmania fastuosa, commonly known as the Queen's Tears or Queen of the Jungle, is a species of flowering plant in the family Bromeliaceae. This epiphytic plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, such as digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Guzmania fastuosa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its ability to alleviate symptoms and promote well-being. The bioactive constituents of Guzmania fastuosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
